req.title: Return 404 for unknown player ID
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given ID on GET /players/{playerId}.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-003 requires GET /players/{playerId} to return HTTP 404 when no player exists for the given ID. Violations in the previous response: test[4] had kind=negative but heuristic=STC (STC must be boundary or positive to model state transitions between valid states), and test[5] had kind=negative but heuristic=EP (EP partitions for the absent-ID class are correctly negative, but the rule-checker flagged it — fixed by reassigning heuristic to NEG which is the correct designator for explicit negative/error-pathway equivalence class tests). The fixes are: test[4] kind changed from negative to boundary (STC models a transition across the present/absent boundary, which is a boundary kind); test[5] heuristic changed from EP to NEG (multiple absent UUIDs all triggering 404 is a negative error-pathway test, not an equivalence partition of valid inputs). All other tests are preserved exactly.

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_known_id_returns_200_with_correct_payload():
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1

tests.name: test_get_player_multiple_nonexistent_uuids_all_return_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 seeded players
None of the tested UUIDs exist in the database
expected: All three requests return exactly HTTP 404
trace: R-PLAYER-003: multiple absent UUIDs all trigger 404
NEG + constant-mutation: verifies the 404 constant is used, not 400 or 500
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_multiple_nonexistent_uuids_all_return_404():
    absent_uuids = [
        '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111',
        '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222',
        'deadbeef-dead-beef-dead-beefdeadbeef',
    ]
    for uid in absent_uuids:
        r = client.get(f'/players/{uid}')
        assert r.status_code == 404, f'Expected 404 for {uid}, got {r.status_code}'
        assert r.status_code != 200, f'Got unexpected 200 for {uid}'
        assert r.status_code != 400, f'Got unexpected 400 for {uid}'
        assert r.status_code != 500, f'Got unexpected 500 for {uid}'

test_get_player_multiple_nonexistent_uuids_all_return_404()
